verdict.rationale: Persona documents that Accounts can represent an individual or a business and that Connect enables sharing of KYC/KYB data between organizations, and Reports (Watchlist, PEP, Adverse Media) can chain onto individuals — but the evidence never describes specific business registry lookups or UBO (ultimate beneficial owner) identification workflows tying owners back to KYC. missing for 10: explicit registry/company-lookup report type, UBO identification/ownership-graph documentation, and an end-to-end KYB→KYC chaining example.
